item.title: Placer County affordable housing project receives final approval
item.description: (FOX40.COM) — An affordable housing project in Placer County was approved by the county’s board of supervisors. The Hope Way Apartments, a 240-unit affordable-housing complex in Penryn, received final approval on Tuesday.
